newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Montreal sheds 5 Chicago fx staff.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal sheds 5 Chicago fx staff.

text.p: Bank of Montreal eliminated five foreign exchange trading positions in Chicago on Tuesday, bringing the total number of U.S. forex staff reductions to nine this week, according to the firm's senior foreign exchange executive.
"We had five trading resources who were eliminated today," said Jamie Thorsen, senior vice president of global foreign exchange in Chicago.
The reductions in the bank's Chicago dealing room came one day after it trimmed four positions -- three sales posts and one administrative worker -- from its New York sales desk.

By way of explanation, Thorsen said that after the foreign exchange operations of Bank of Montreal and its Chicago-based subsidiary Harris Bank were combined in 1995, she had expected more staff reductions through natural attrition.
But in the end this did not happen, she said, adding, "We are completely done, there are no other plans" for layoffs.
